# natter

> Natter is Matter. natter is a simple personal 1:1 real-time messenger. Conversations, made simple.

## Features

- Find people by username search
- Real-time messages over WebSocket
- Sent and read receipts
- Typing indicator
- Block users
- Delete a chat (for me only)
- Delete your account
- Guest mode: enter a name and optional contact to chat with the developer
- Embeddable guest chat widget
- Light, dark and system theme
- English and Indonesian

## Privacy

- Messages are not end-to-end encrypted; server administrators can read messages.
- Conversations are deleted after 1 month without activity.
- Guest accounts end after 30 minutes of inactivity; their conversation is kept for up to 1 month.

## Technology

- Backend: Go (Gin), PostgreSQL, WebSocket
- Frontend: React, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS
- Open source under the MIT license
